# Scarcity and luxury

Luxury is scarcity that has been given a story. Gold, saffron, a watch with a waiting list: the price holds because supply is limited, and supply is often limited on purpose.

## Where it meets the commodity notes

Some raw materials move from industrial input to object of desire and back. In a boom, copper and lithium are talked about the way people talk about a fashionable district. See [[Commodity supercycle]].

## Question

Is a waiting list a form of advertising? It shows other people wanting, which is the oldest way to make a want.
